name: E2E Tests

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - develop
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - develop

jobs:
  e2e:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - name: Set up JDK 21
        uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '21'
          cache: maven

      - name: Create environment file
        run: |
          cat > .env <<EOF
          SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE=dev
          JWT_SECRET=${{ secrets.JWT_SECRET }}
          AWS_REGION=us-east-1
          AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=test
          AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=test
          POSTGRES_AUTH_DB=eventpassauth
          POSTGRES_AUTH_USER=postgres
          POSTGRES_AUTH_PASSWORD=password
          POSTGRES_AUTH_PORT=5432
          POSTGRES_EVENTS_DB=eventpassevents
          POSTGRES_EVENTS_USER=postgres
          POSTGRES_EVENTS_PASSWORD=password
          POSTGRES_EVENTS_PORT=5433
          POSTGRES_ORDERS_DB=eventpassorders
          POSTGRES_ORDERS_USER=postgres
          POSTGRES_ORDERS_PASSWORD=password
          POSTGRES_ORDERS_PORT=5434
          REDIS_PORT=6379
          LOCALSTACK_PORT=4566
          MONGODB_TICKETS_PORT=27018
          MONGODB_TICKETS_DATABASE=eventpasstickets
          MS_ORDERS_CLIENT_ID=ms-orders
          MS_ORDERS_CLIENT_SECRET=ms-orders-secret
          E2E_ADMIN_EMAIL=admin@eventpass.cl
          E2E_ADMIN_PASSWORD=Cambiame123!
          EOF

      - name: Start platform
        run: docker compose --env-file .env up -d --build

      - name: Wait for services
        run: |
          for i in {1..60}; do
            if docker compose ps | grep -q "ms-tickets.*healthy" &&
               docker compose ps | grep -q "ms-orders.*healthy" &&
               docker compose ps | grep -q "ms-events.*healthy" &&
               docker compose ps | grep -q "ms-auth.*healthy"; then
              echo "All services are healthy"
              exit 0
            fi
            sleep 5
          done
          docker compose ps
          docker compose logs --tail=200
          exit 1

      - name: Run E2E tests
        env:
          E2E_ADMIN_EMAIL: admin@eventpass.cl
          E2E_ADMIN_PASSWORD: Cambiame123!
        run: >
          ./ms-auth/mvnw -f e2e-tests/pom.xml
          "-Dit.test=EventPassPurchaseFlowIT,OrderCancellationRestoresCapacityIT,OrderPerUserLimitIT,OrderInsufficientCapacityIT,TicketAccessControlIT"
          verify

      - name: Show logs on failure
        if: failure()
        run: |
          docker compose ps
          docker compose logs --tail=300
